gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Whimsical but firm, Flavors stamps out chunky diagonals and a towering lowercase with no hairlines anywhere. Noto Sans Malayalam settles beside it, approachable and sturdy, its middle zone filling each line like a friendly handshake.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Whimsical and loud, Flavors plants tall pencil-stub letters with diagonals as hefty as its stems. Noto Sans Mandaic does the quieter job, keeping its curvy, unclamped lowercase close to capital height while the heading does the shouting.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Chunky, towering, a little cheeky. Noto Sans Marchen then carries the text, its proud small letters and curves ending in clear daylight, so a long stretch of it stays easy on the eye.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numerals: Flavors writes like a fixed-width nib, with no hairlines and diagonals as stout as its stems. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals follows with tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c, so a long passage feels contemporary and steady.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Flavors is the show-off here, with bowls as heavy as its stems and a stubby, towering lowercase. Noto Sans Medefaidrin is the one that keeps going, its high lowercase and clean curve turns made for steady text.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and large lowercase eyes, so text feels modern and open. And Flavors sits above it with crossbars as thick as its stems, whimsical and loud.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui reads modern and clean, with daylight through every curve and lowercase standing tall. Flavors is the loud one; Mende Kikakui is the patient one.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-mono: Flavors looks bent from a single length of wire. Its job is to command with whimsical diagonals, while Noto Sans Mono spaces sturdy, tall lowercase letters generously so every word stays clear.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-multani: Whimsical, wiry and stubby tall, with every stroke ending at one measured thickness. Noto Sans Multani follows with a lofty x-height and an e that gapes at its terminal, so a long passage feels modern and unhurried.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Pencil-stub tall and whimsical, drawn with a constant-width pen line. Noto Sans Nandinagari brings the pair's strongest quality: generous openings and a big, short-ascender lowercase that feel approachable at any weight.
